verses.1: Unto the end. For the wine and oil presses. A Psalm to the sons of Korah.
verses.2: How beloved are your tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!
verses.3: My soul longs and faints for the courts of the Lord. My heart and my flesh have exulted in the living God.
verses.4: For even the sparrow has found a home for himself, and the turtle-dove a nest for herself, where she may lay her young: your altars, O Lord of hosts, my king and my God.
verses.5: Blessed are those who dwell in your house, O Lord. They will praise you from age to age.
verses.6: Blessed is the man whose help is from you. In his heart, he is disposed to ascend
verses.7: from the valley of tears, from the place which he has determined.
verses.8: For even the lawgiver will provide a blessing; they will go from virtue to virtue. The God of gods will be seen in Zion.
verses.9: O Lord, God of hosts, hear my prayer. Pay attention, O God of Jacob.
verses.10: O God, gaze upon our protector, and look upon the face of your Christ.
verses.11: For one day in your courts is better than thousands elsewhere. I have chosen to be lowly in the house of my God, rather than to dwell in the tabernacles of sinners.
verses.12: For God loves mercy and truth. The Lord will give grace and glory.
verses.13: He will not withhold good things from those who walk in innocence. O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man who hopes in you. [ Psalm 84 ] (85)
